description: This file contains utility functions and constants for the Notesnook mobile editor, including state management, WebView communication, internal link handling, and event subscriptions.

methods.name: editorState
methods.description: Returns the current editor state or a default state if not ready.

methods.name: randId
methods.description: Generates a random ID string with a given prefix.

methods.name: makeSessionId
methods.description: Creates a session ID, optionally appending a provided ID.

methods.name: isEditorLoaded
methods.description: Checks if the editor WebView is loaded by sending a status request.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Sends a message to the WebView and waits for a response.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Waits for a specific response event from the WebView.

methods.name: waitForEvent
methods.description: Waits for a specified event to occur within a timeout.

methods.name: isContentInvalid
methods.description: Checks if the provided content string is invalid or empty.

methods.name: getAppState
methods.description: Retrieves the stored app state if valid, otherwise loads from module.

methods.name: openInternalLink
methods.description: Parses and handles internal links, possibly scrolling or loading notes.
